description: Weles, the old Slavic god of herds, wealth and the underworld, a dignified dark elder with a long black beard streaked with grey and long black hair, two great curved ox horns growing from his head, calm deep-set eyes with a faint green glow, a heavy dark brown bear fur cloak over his shoulders, a twisted gold torque at his neck and a string of old gold coins, head and shoulders portrait, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, slavic pagan mythology, dignified, muted natural colours
